newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Nomura gives Czech IPB CZK 12 bln support.
newsitem.headline: Nomura gives Czech IPB CZK 12 bln support.

text.p: Prague-based Investicni a Postovni Banka a.s. said on Tuesday that Nomura Securities Ltd would extend a 12 billion crown credit line to IPB which was termed to "financial support" for IPB.

"The (IPB) board of directors has taken all necessary steps to strengthen and protect the stability of the bank including signing an agreement with Nomura International for granting financial support in the amount of 12 billion crowns," said an IPB statement after an extraordinary general meeting.
An IPB official later said that the support was in the form of a credit line.
Further details on what the credit would be used for, or why it was necessary, were not immediately available.
Nomura effectively holds a roughly 10 percent stake in IPB through a Czech-based firm Nutshell s.r.o., and has been seeking to increase its equity participation in the bank.
Nomura is one of the two front-runners in a tender to acquire a 36 percent stake held by Czech state agencies in IPB.
Dutch ING Bank is the other finalist in the tender which is expected to be completed this year.
